layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Carnivore diet symbolism
features: A stylized, cartoonish T-bone steak made of smooth clay
The meat is a soft reddish-pink clay with a thick white clay border and a white T-shaped bone in the center
Smooth, rounded edges to maintain a toy-like, friendly aesthetic
Soft studio lighting with gentle highlights
layer_3_action.action: A clean, centered shot of a clay T-bone steak sitting on a simple clay surface. The background is a soft, neutral out-of-focus color. The image is designed as a clear icon or symbol to indicate a meat-eating diet for a children's matching game. No text.
